data.narrative:
Elementl Power is a Series A nuclear energy company that has raised $50M+ to date. The broader nuclear energy sector comprises 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Fuse Energy, Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable here. Using total capital raised of $50M as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A to subsequent-stage progression, this method yields $100M. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the nuclear energy subsector—only one same-stage peer and one adjacent-stage peer were identified, falling short of the three-datapoint threshold needed for reliable median analysis.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $85M to $115M, with a median point of $100M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around appropriate step-up multiples for frontier nuclear technologies and the absence of tighter peer benchmarking. Key unknowns include the company's specific technology differentiation relative to the peer set, capital efficiency to date, and path to revenue or deployment, none of which are quantified in available data.
